title: Live camera pipeline with configurable sampling
purpose: Provide a continuous, battery-aware camera frame source with cheap preprocessing and configurable sampling to downstream vision.
architecturalScope: Perception bounded context. CameraPort / SensorSource. Owns frame capture, downscaling, throttling; does not perform recognition itself.
domainContext: CameraFrame, Timestamp. Frame metadata (size, orientation) as value objects.

milestones.title: Frame capture and throttling
milestones.description: Frames flow at 30 FPS with cheap preprocessing; vision sampling configurable separately.

tasks.title: Define CameraPort and CameraFrame
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline testable with a synthetic frame source.

tasks.title: Implement capture with configurable FPS and downscaling
acceptanceCriteria: Camera and vision sampling rates are independently configurable.
Frame buffers are released after use.
evidence: configurable sampling in app/src/ui/main.ts; device profiling pending

acceptanceCriteria: The vision loop can sample 1-3 FPS while the camera runs faster.
No frame is persisted to disk.

risks.description: Continuous camera drains battery and heats the device.
risks.mitigation: Configurable sampling, downscaling, pause when not needed.

safetyImplications: Frames are advisory input only; the pipeline must not imply obstacle clearance.
accessibilityImplications: Pipeline must keep serving frames while the screen is off or UI is not visible.
privacyImplications: Frames are ephemeral in memory, never stored or uploaded by default.
